nations.name: Ute Indian Tribe
also: Ute Indian Tribe of the Uintah and Ouray Reservation
nations.lands: Uintah and Ouray Reservation, northeastern Utah, with tribal government at Fort Duchesne, United States

facts.text: On September 22, 2021, the Ute Indian Tribe and National Park Service finalized an agreement for the Tribe’s Historic Preservation Office to assume certain duties on Tribal lands.

source.title: Ute Indian Tribal Historic Preservation Office agreement effective immediately
source.publisher: Ute Indian Tribe of the Uintah and Ouray Reservation, via ICT Press Pool

facts.evidence: to exercise certain cultural and historic preservation activities
